reviews.text:
Today was my first time at Angel City and I was very happy with my experience! I was helped right at my appointment time, the staff were kind and welcoming, the doctor asked many questions and provided helpful information for my doggie’s health and the pricing was reasonable from my experience at other animal clinics. Because of their expertise, service and timeliness, I will come again.

It’s appointment only so book in advance. I was able to book with one day notice.

They will try to charge you $1,000 every time you going for a checkup. Constantly over diagnosing and vastly expensive to alternative veterinarians. If you need a prescription from a pharmacy that your pet needs, they won't order it they make you do it yourself.

I made an appointment over the phone, and when I called, they wanted to charge me—I can't believe it! They haven't even examined my cat yet, and they want me to pay for the appointment in advance. They are thieves. Look for another clinic; all they care about is money.
Truly an awful clinic. Do not bring your pet here.

Staff both front desk and doctor were great. Scheduling was easy. everything was explained to us very clearly, were not pressured into anything and pricing was very fair. Overall experience was great for us and our cat.

I took my cat here today. It had refused food for six days and was vomiting incessantly. I had strong faith in this place because my elderly dog ​​had successful dental surgery here before. Sure enough, as soon as my cat returned from the vet, it ate its food on its own. It was so amazing and felt like a miracle. I highly recommend taking any sick animal to Angel City Veterinary Hospital without hesitation. For reference, several hospitals had given up on treating my old dog; I even took it to the emergency room, but they said surgery was too risky. I had actually paid a $500 deposit at an extremely expensive dental specialty clinic. I happened to find Angel City Veterinary Hospital by chance, and we forfeited the $500 deposit to come here. My dog ​​recovered well and is doing wonderfully to this day. At Angel City Veterinary Hospital, my critically ill dog and cat were given a new lease on life. Doctor... thank you so much...

Dr Choi saved my lestat’s life by suggesting and conducting laser surgery on her very aggressive stomatitis. My poor cat completely changed for the better and became the happy healthy furball she is now

I have never had issues with the quality of service here but I will say the prices are extremely high when compared elsewhere. I visited last week to get a small growth removed from my dog's neck. The amount they quoted was close to $3,000. I visited another vet and got the procedure taken care of for $560. For routine shots this is a good spot but for anything major I would recommend shopping around.

The doctor has great passion and definitely cares for the animals. She has a lot of knowledge to help others and knows what she's doing. Very friendly staff. Experience for yourself.. you will know...
This is an update for 2 years of experience going to this place. I did see some bad reviews that made me skeptical at first, but I made the right choice to become their patient. My dog loves every staff member in that hospital. Don't believe the bad reviews because they wouldn't say every single thing happened at the hospital. Like I said, experience it...

My saki has been going to see Dr. Choi and the amazing team for about a year now. He just got a bladder stone removal and neuter surgery which is why I am leaving this review. The whole team has been so caring and so good at responding with any questions I may have. They really listen to what you feel comfortable with while providing amazing care. Saki is doing amazing post surgery and the whole team has been checking up with him. So happy I found them!
This people is not nice I come early do costumer yet im the only one here but they don't what to see my dog yet but im early as in no costumer yet but this lady said no you  have to wait

I've been bringing my dog to Dr. Choi for 4 years now, and I couldn't be happier with the care we receive. Dr. Choi is an exceptional veterinarian who truly cares about their animal patients and takes the time to communicate everything clearly with pet owners. The practice makes scheduling easy, whether it's for routine check-ups or more urgent matters.

When we bring out dog in for vaccinations it takes less than 5 minutes.  The staff is prepared and organized.

What sets Dr. Choi apart is their genuine compassion and thoroughness during every visit. They always make sure both pets and their owners feel comfortable and well-informed. If you're looking for a trustworthy and caring veterinarian, I highly recommend Dr. Choi!

Unfortunately a place where I actually wanted to take my pet recommended this place and I’m not sure why. Besides that they had earlier available appointments. I spent almost $1000 in this place and when I asked to use the bathroom before I …

Professional, friend, Clear price.
Btw, mobile payments were not accepted.

I've been coming here for 5 years and I've felt well taken care of. While my dog is recovering from surgery, the front desk has been incredibly accommodating, indulging me in phone and photo/email check-ins just to give me peace of mind. …
They require a 75$ deposit for new animals. And since theyre a "private hospital" they wont combine visits for 2 animals in the same household.
